name: Hetaro Pearlbaton
japaneseName: ヘータロー・パールバトン
description: Hetaro Pearlbaton is one of the three vice captains of the mercenary squad Iron Fang and a trusted retainer of the Anastasia Camp. One of the Pearlbaton triplets alongside his sister Mimi and brother Tivey, he acts as the calm, responsible tactician and battlefield commander.
